notifications.name: Hydraglow Rose Enrich Serum Cream 50g
notifications.danger: According to the list of ingredients, the product has an excessive concentration of ethylhexyl methoxycinnamate, butyl methoxydibenzoylmethane, phenoxyethanol, methylparaben and isopropylparaben. Ethylhexyl methoxycinnamate could be an endocrine disruptor and might cause skin irritation. Butyl methoxydibenzoylmethane might cause allergic reaction and skin irritation. Phenoxyethanol is haematotoxic, a mild irritant and may damage blood and liver. Methylparaben could cause skin irritation. Isopropylparaben might be toxic for reproduction and development, and might specifically target the male reproductive system. Moreover, the product contains fragrance allergens, which are not indicated in the list of ingredients. The product does not comply with the Cosmetic Products Regulation.

notifications.danger: The product has an excessive volume of nicotine-containing liquid (30 ml) and an excessive concentration of nicotine (50 mg/ml). Nicotine is acutely toxic and can endanger the user’s safety, notably if the product comes into contact with the skin or is ingested. Additionally, the product lacks an information leaflet. As a consequence, consumers cannot make informed decisions regarding the safe use of the product. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Tobacco Products Directive.
